text: Play the story from the opening mission Gone Fishing through Chapters 1–4 to the final mission. Every chapter and named-mission trophy unlocks automatically as you finish it. The one thing you must do inside the story: meditate at Jason's house before Chapter 1 ends — PowerPyx flags it as the game's only missable moment, and there is no mission replay.
title: Story first — Chapters 1–4 and the finale

text: Stranger mission strands unlock as you explore Leonida. Each contact has a chain of missions ending in a final one; finish all eight strands for the silver. Work one strand at a time whenever its marker appears.
title: Strangers & contacts

text: Sample every activity, then grind the ones with trophies: 250 stunts, gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, drone races at 14 locations, 20 different race wins, 50 challenges, bowling at Kolt & Associates, an arcade game, and a fishing win over Cal. Activities also feed the 100% checklist.
title: Activities & challenges

text: Sweep Leonida district by district: all 18 meditation spots (the first one in Chapter 1 — see Missables), 3 collectible card sets, WAiNK It at 100 locations, 100 vehicles discovered, all 52 areas explored, and all 8 garage properties bought. One careful sweep covers several trophies at once.
title: Exploration & collectibles

text: The crime sandbox: partner robberies, bank vaults, armored trucks, gang operations, Combat Focus, the Rhino tank, and the money trophies — $250,000 laundered, $100,000 spent. Keep cheats off the whole time: PowerPyx notes cheats disable trophies and saving. Watch the Criminal Profile warning on Actions Speak Louder — the Irredeemable profile is permanent.
title: Open-world chaos & crime

text: Finish the 100% Completion checklist after the story: 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts, 200 of 277 base-model vehicles scanned and 100 of 255 animals studied through binoculars (PowerPyx). Most of it is already done if you followed the earlier stages. When A Long Road pops, the platinum — Vice Got a Price! — follows at once.
title: 100% completion & the platinum
